verdict.rationale: Twilio Video documents a public REST API. Its Rooms resource lets you create Rooms and set the name, type, TURN configuration, status callback URL and maximum Participants. Status Callbacks cover the REST-managed Rooms, Recordings and Compositions resources, so the core of programmatically driving the product is clearly documented first-party. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API use, and evidence on the breadth of the API reference (e.g. Participants, Recordings and Compositions endpoint details, authentication).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use this API to set Room properties such as its name, type, TURN configuration, webhook status callback URL, and the maximum number of Participants.
This makes it easier to interact with Twilio's REST API without having to keep track of Twilio's Room SID identifiers.
Status Callbacks allow you to receive events related to the REST resources managed by Twilio: Rooms, Recordings, and Compositions.
Configure a `StatusCallback` URL when creating a Room using the REST API
